reason: test whether trajectory design alone repairs observability with the single-channel sensing modality; dual routes remain 2 m formation-feasible for a later same-data D2 comparator
route_ranking_lexicographic: number of design winds with numerical rank 3
worst-design-wind maximum corrected Q_energy over frozen 5 s and 10 s windows
minimum source exposure count and minimum number of exposed temporal thirds
exposure_gate: every source in every design wind has processed response above 0.1 ppm in at least two temporal thirds
collision_gate: no exactly identical source-response pair in either design wind
q_energy_definition: for each wind and window length, R_l=(I-11T/4)Y_l, M_energy=sum_l R_l R_lT, Q_energy=lambda3(M_energy)/lambda1(M_energy)
q_energy_gate: for every design wind, max Q_energy over the two frozen window lengths >= 0.01
route_pass: all rank, sigma, Q_energy, collision, and exposure gates pass in both design winds
